root_cause: Protected #4699 deployed the transitive Brain operating-loop function but Production Release Readback #39830412618 classified portal_required=false on a backend runtime change and skipped existing Verify authenticated Portal production API proof. Correct exact provider SHA alone is not authenticated per-tenant outcome proof.
impact: Release workflow can report success while customer-authenticated portal and tenant boundary remain unverified after deployed Brain runtime changes.
fix: Reuse the existing authenticated Portal production proof step whenever the imported Brain runtime paths change; preserve portal lane original trigger and existing exact SHA/deploy/tenant validation. No second verifier or scheduler.
prevention_rule: Brain runtime imports must not allow a green production release unless the existing exact-deploy authenticated tenant proof succeeds; 401/403/invalid or missing proof stays red. Two-tenant acceptance remains separately required.
